product.title: Paris Private Tour

description.text: Covering Paris in a short stay can overwhelm even the savviest visitors. Treat yourself to a smooth and stress-free introduction to the City of Lights during this private half-day tour. Stops include Place du Trocadéro, Eiffel Tower, Shakespeare and Company, Notre-Dame Cathedral of Paris. Tick off blockbusters like the Eiffel Tower, and discover locally beloved landmarks like Shakespeare and Co bookshop. Ideal for visitors basing in Paris who want a guided city experience without coordinating Metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Place du Trocadéro, Eiffel Tower, Shakespeare and Company, Notre-Dame Cathedral of Paris that define this Paris sightseeing experience, with a guide handling Metro connections, ticket windows, and neighborhood pacing so the day stays focused on the city rather than logistics.
